gui.pccard.pattern_buffer.blocking.disab: Pattern pushes bypass general buffer blocking; circuit-conflict protection remains active.
gui.pccard.pattern_buffer.blocking.enabl: Checks the selected mode before accepting each pattern push.
Waits for all non-circuit buffered inputs to clear before accepting another pattern.

gui.pccard.pattern_buffer.card.tooltip: Accepts one Programmed Circuit Card to decode circuit inputs and control the shared GTCEu circuit slot.
gui.pccard.pattern_buffer.card.locked: Card changes are locked while non-circuit inputs remain buffered.
